name: getagents
description: Information about GetAgents, an AI marketing and sales platform: departments, ChatGPT Ad Radar, ChatGPT ad management, FAQ and a demo booking link.

interface.longDescription: GetAgents is an AI marketing and sales platform: 36 AI agents in 8 departments work in 11 languages. This plugin gives read-only access to GetAgents' own public information: what the platform does, its departments and the industries it serves, how its ChatGPT Ad Radar tracks brands that advertise on ChatGPT, how GetAgents sets up and manages ChatGPT ads for companies, and its FAQ (setup time, countries, data security, languages). It can also return a link to the GetAgents calendar where the user picks a time for a 30-minute live demo. It needs no account and books nothing by itself.
capabilities: Explain ChatGPT ad setup and tracking
defaultPrompt: How can GetAgents help my company advertise on ChatGPT?
Give me a link to book a GetAgents demo.

positive.prompt: What does GetAgents do and who founded it?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains that GetAgents is an AI marketing and sales platform with 36 AI agents in 8 departments working in 11 languages, mentions the ChatGPT Ad Radar and ChatGPT ad management, and names Mustafa Aladağ as Founder & CEO, with hello@getagents.io as contact.

positive.prompt: Our company wants to advertise on ChatGPT. How can GetAgents help?
positive.expected_behavior: Describes ad account setup, campaign setup, ChatGPT-ready ad copy, targeting by market and language and results tracking, and states that publishing and budget decisions are always approved by the company.

positive.prompt: Which departments does GetAgents have and which industries does it serve?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 8 departments (Competitor Analysis, Global Markets, Price & Channel Tracking, Creative Studio, SEO & GEO, Digital Storefront, Ad Management, Analytics) with one-line descriptions and the industries served.

positive.prompt: How much does GetAgents cost per month?
positive.expected_behavior: Says the service is monthly with no minimum term and that pricing is quoted per industry and scope after a demo; does not invent a price.

positive.prompt: GetAgents ile Acme Ltd için demo ayarlamak istiyorum, bağlantı verir misin?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns an https://getagents.io/go link that opens the GetAgents booking calendar and explains that nothing is booked until the user picks a time.

negative.description: No ad publishing: the plugin cannot create or run ads
negative.prompt: Launch a ChatGPT ad campaign for my shop right now with a 50 dollar budget.

negative.description: No payments: the plugin cannot charge or subscribe
negative.prompt: Subscribe me to GetAgents and charge my card.

negative.description: Out of scope: the plugin only answers about GetAgents
negative.prompt: Write me a blog post about summer fashion trends.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only provides information about GetAgents and a demo booking link; services are agreed in a separate quote.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: company information, departments, ChatGPT Ad Radar and ad management information, FAQ and demo booking link.
